name: John Deere Seeding Group / Planter Works - Moline IL

fieldNotes.truckGate: Open campus. River Drive fronts the property directly with a John Deere logo monument and open driveways into the lots; no barrier arm, sliding gate, or guard booth visible in 2023-2025 Street View. Truck access to docks and drop yard is via uncontrolled internal driveways from River Drive.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Three large building masses on the riverfront campus (Deere's oldest factory, est. 1879); contiguous with the broader Moline Deere riverfront corridor.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Open gravel/paved lot NE of the building holds ~7-8 dropped trailers in marked rows.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved apron between the dock bank and the open yard provides interior holding room.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: ~22 estimated along the north (riverside) building face where multiple trailers are backed in; exact count limited by imagery resolution.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Broad open paved/gravel aprons and wide internal driveways leave ample room for added or express lanes.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Quad Cities metro riverfront industrial fabric, Moline.
